svg.aria-label: Nüsha — Shafa's forerunner: write, print, keep the record. A computer prescription system for one doctor — on the web, as an Android APK and as a Windows install. Six paper templates, bilingual letterhead, patient history with vitals and diagnosis. Patient data never leaves the machine.
